claims.claim: Base-set and identical endpoint boundaries precede non-exempt attribute comparison.
The highest-priority prohibition removes the equivalence class; a lower prohibition can be overridden.
A targetRole changes the role selected for consecutive relationships.
An unusable member does not prune descendants; a false path excludes the member within the effective domain.
Global default assignment does not create domain membership.
No retained base-set/endpoint pair repeats, so actual equivalence groups are singleton before attribute comparison.
